title: OpenAI hands NATO's cyber defenders its Daybreak models
summary: OpenAI said NATO's core institutions now use its Daybreak cyber models through the alliance's communications and information agency, with usage reaching up to 300 billion tokens a month. The disclosed work covers reviewing software, investigating suspicious activity, validating vulnerabilities and testing fixes. NATO's Crossed Swords exercise in Tallinn this month ran a stream in which participants directed AI agents under human oversight. EU and national cyber agencies, and Ukraine's digital ministry, also hold Daybreak access.
